starters: Place MCU and OLEDSeat esp32-s3-zero and SSD1306 OLED on the breadboard with clear access to 3V3, GND, GPIO8, GPIO9.
Power the OLEDWire mcu.3V3 → oled.VCC and mcu.GND → oled.GND. OLED is 3.3V only — do not use 5V.
I2C busWire mcu.GPIO8 → oled.SDA and mcu.GPIO9 → oled.SCL (board default I2C).
Run in simFlash/run firmware. Serial should print S3_OK; OLED should show Hello S3.
rows: • ESP32-S3 with OLED: show Hello S3 on SSD1306 and print S3_OK on serial. Prove on twin.
